title: "Paired synthetic study walkthrough"
format: html
execute:
  echo: true
  cache: false
  freeze: false
---

This walkthrough runs the installed `triomics` command line on a public synthetic
paired study. The six subjects each have a baseline and followup sample. The
analysis table and figure below are read from the completed report; this document
does not fit or refit a model.

```{r}
if (!requireNamespace("triomics", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("The archive-installed triomics package is required.", call. = FALSE)
}
project_root <- triomics:::triomics_reproduction_find_project_root(getwd())
evidence_root <- Sys.getenv("TRIOMICS_PACKET_EVIDENCE_ROOT", unset = "")
if (!nzchar(evidence_root) || !dir.exists(evidence_root)) {
  stop("Set TRIOMICS_PACKET_EVIDENCE_ROOT to a local evidence directory.", call. = FALSE)
}
fixture_root <- tempfile("paired-fixture-", tmpdir = evidence_root)
fixture <- triomics:::triomics_reproduction_materialize_fixture("paired", fixture_root)
output_root <- tempfile("paired-installed-run-", tmpdir = evidence_root)
run <- triomics:::triomics_reproduction_run_installed(
  fixture, output_root, project_root = project_root
)
```

## Saved paired results

The producer stages validate, prepare, analyze, integrate, and render the paired
fixture. The following rows retain stable feature identities, six subjects, six
complete pairs, and the target-minus-reference delta difference.

```{r}
saved_results <- utils::read.delim(
  file.path(output_root, "report", "results.tsv"),
  check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
paired_results <- saved_results[
  saved_results$block_id == "block_1" &
    saved_results$contrast_id == "target_minus_reference",
  , drop = FALSE
]
paired_results <- paired_results[order(paired_results$feature_key), , drop = FALSE]
stopifnot(
  nrow(paired_results) > 0L,
  all(startsWith(paired_results$feature_key, "fk1|")),
  all(paired_results$representation_id == "delta"),
  all(paired_results$effect_unit == "delta_difference"),
  all(paired_results$n_subjects == 6L),
  all(paired_results$n_pairs == 6L)
)
knitr::kable(
  paired_results[c(
    "feature_key", "n_subjects", "n_pairs", "effect", "effect_unit"
  )],
  digits = 4,
  caption = "Saved paired effects from six baseline/followup subject pairs"
)
```

```{r}
graphics::dotchart(
  paired_results$effect,
  labels = paired_results$feature_key,
  xlab = "Followup minus baseline effect (synthetic arbitrary units)",
  main = "Saved paired effects by stable feature key"
)
```

## Reproduction receipt

The receipt records successful software execution while leaving scientific and
packet acceptance pending. Synthetic data establish software behavior only.

```{r}
knitr::kable(data.frame(
  item = c(
    "Installed source revision", "Execution status", "Scientific validation",
    "Packet acceptance", "Manifest ID", "Manifest byte SHA-256",
    "Packet / requirement records", "Conditional scope records"
  ),
  value = c(
    run$installed$source_revision,
    run$manifest$execution_status,
    run$manifest$scientific_validation_status,
    run$manifest$packet_acceptance_status,
    run$manifest$manifest_id,
    run$manifest_byte_sha256,
    paste(run$manifest$programme_accounting$packet_count,
          run$manifest$programme_accounting$requirement_count, sep = " / "),
    run$manifest$programme_accounting$conditional_scope_count
  ),
  check.names = FALSE
))
```

This walkthrough contains no missing measurement or clinical values and does not
claim missingness coverage. Sol's merged clinical smoke should use the accepted
D-T15 fixture to verify the supported complete-case exclusion path.
